PLAY · DESIGNING A WORLD

Rainbow Fish Aquarium

Color the fish, then draw its aquarium home in the frame.

HOW TO DO IT

Read, then draw.

Color the fish, then draw its aquarium home in the frame.

The fish wiggle their thanks!

YOUR PENCIL CASE

Pick your tools.

Pencil, nine crayons, an eraser, undo, redo and clear appear right here and work straight on the picture. Save keeps your finished work as a picture.

MY PROGRESS

Save it to keep it.

This adventure is cleared for you the moment you save your finished picture. Nothing counts until then — opening the page is just opening the door.

Cleared! A beautiful aquarium! Your saved work is in your downloads, and the ribbon is on in the library.

PREFER PAPER?

Print the twin.

The same picture lives in the worksheet library with its own print buttons: /worksheets/colors/rainbow-fish-aquarium/. Crayons beat styluses sometimes.

FOR GROWN-UPS

Why this activity helps.

This studio turns designing a world into open-ended making. Children choose, tap and see the picture answer at once — and because nothing is graded, the choices are truly theirs. Naming colors out loud as they work doubles the learning, and the undo button means a brave choice is never a risk.

Finished pieces are saved straight from the pencil case — Save composes the child's drawing over the original artwork as one picture, and an adventure counts as cleared only when that save really happens. Everything stays on this device, private by design.
